description:
COSTS MONEY: Renew an expired phone number

Pays the open monthly fee of an expired number from your balance and makes it reachable again, like the renew button on the billing page. Only numbers of your own account with status `expired`.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: renew_phone_number
title: Renew an expired phone number
